## What changes and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue or governing
requirement when relevant.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Note any checks not run and why.
CPU and Fake-engine tests do not qualify a native engine recipe. For native
results, include the engine/model versions, hardware, configuration and scope.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and targets `main`.
- [ ] Relevant tests and user documentation are updated.
- [ ] Spec-driven behavior cites its requirement; acceptance tests carry their T-ID where applicable.
- [ ] Shared examples and evidence contain no secrets, private data or machine identifiers.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/edurdias/capyctl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for verification commands and contribution terms.
